entries.subject: Karkoschka (2001) adopted Voyager/HST shape
entries.finding: Table IV of the HST study supplies the adopted prolate semiaxes 27 × 19 × 19 km. The repeated minor axis is a model assumption, not an independently measured third dimension. French et al. (2024), Table 3 reproduces the separate Voyager size paper’s projected-radius and axis-ratio uncertainties; they are not individual-axis errors. The selected analytic shape supplies no local relief or surface pixels.

entries.subject: PDS Voyager ISS, processed calibrated imagery
entries.finding: Sorted 3,727 indexed Ophelia observations by body-center sampling. Best C2687614 has 11.70539 km per native pixel: at most 4.6 samples across the longest diameter, at phase 150.593°. Downloaded and inspected its actual GEOMED image and label. A 15.36 s ring observation at this crescent phase does not support a useful cartographic surface. Geometric resampling adds no native detail.
entries.revisitWhen: A Ophelia observation or controlled reconstruction demonstrates useful native surface detail, body-fixed geometry and independent registration beyond the cited sampling or coverage limits.

entries.subject: Lower-phase Voyager observation C2676439
entries.finding: Phase 15.799° but 33.48036 km per native pixel, fewer than two samples along the longest diameter. Metadata retained; not adopted as a surface map.
entries.revisitWhen: A Ophelia observation or controlled reconstruction demonstrates useful native surface detail, body-fixed geometry and independent registration beyond the cited sampling or coverage limits.

entries.subject: French 2024 occultation/ring analysis
entries.finding: Included for shape uncertainties, ring relationships and dynamically inferred mass. Ring waves are not a spatial map of the moon.

entries.subject: HST photometry/recovery and observer account
entries.finding: Recover position and integrated brightness, not resolved surface texels. No Color lens qualified.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially resolved Ophelia measurement supplies original spectral or image samples with body-fixed coordinates and enough coverage to qualify a mapped lens.

entries.subject: USGS mapping, PDS shape releases, JPL texture catalog
entries.finding: No usable registered surface map, detailed mesh, elevation or geology field located. This is a survey disposition, not proof that no future data could exist.
entries.revisitWhen: The inspected shape archive or a cited primary release publishes a Ophelia-specific numerical model with its frame, units and reconstruction method.

entries.subject: NASA overview
entries.finding: Used for discovery and ring-shepherd context; newer primary dimensions and mass take precedence over old physical estimates.
